failure_summary.description: The agent treated a cached result as sufficient even though the latest user turn added a rating criterion that was not reflected in the cache summary.

patch.reasoning: Make the cache-sufficiency check explicitly account for new criteria anywhere in the latest turn, including turns that begin with an affirmation, and clarify that any unmet or unverified criterion requires updating a compatible cached result.

edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints in filters that were already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
edits.content: - On each turn, parse the entire latest user turn, including any criteria stated after an affirmation, and compare every active criterion with compatible cached result summaries. A cache is not sufficient merely because it matches the subject or earlier criteria: if even one active criterion is absent or not known to be satisfied, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the missing criterion(s), and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cache does not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results satisfy every active criterion in the current request.
